title: Weight-management review: questions to take with you
description: Build a free checklist for a weight-management conversation: getting started, progress, treatment concerns and follow-up. No account or health details needed.

/articles/wegovy-side-effects-timeline.heading: Make a routine review easier
/articles/wegovy-side-effects-timeline.text: For a non-urgent conversation, pick questions about symptoms and follow-up with the free review checklist. For symptoms needing urgent help, use the warning signs and healthcare routes above; do not wait for a routine review.

/articles/nhs-weight-loss-drugs.heading: Take clear questions to the conversation
/articles/nhs-weight-loss-drugs.text: Use the free review checklist to organise questions about available support and what happens next. It cannot confirm NHS eligibility, arrange a referral or promise access to a medicine.

/articles/weight-loss-plateau-men.heading: Bring the pattern and the question
/articles/weight-loss-plateau-men.text: Use the free review checklist to choose questions about readings, everyday routines and the next review. A checklist cannot identify why progress has slowed or make a treatment decision.

/tools.heading: Turn a result into useful questions
/tools.text: A number is a starting point. Use the free review checklist to prepare questions for your GP or treating service, without entering health details on this website.
